description.zh: 豊川稲荷（正式名称：圆福山妙严寺）是日本三大稻荷之一，也是极为特殊的「寺院型稻荷」——以佛教曹洞宗寺院的形式供奉稻荷大明神，融合神佛习合传统。境内有约1,000座红色鸟居连排而成的「灵狐塚」，是豊川最引人入胜的景点。
description.en: Toyokawa Inari (formally Empukuzan Myōgon-ji) is one of Japan's three great Inari shrines and uniquely a Buddhist temple-style Inari — a Sōtō Zen temple that enshrines Inari Daimyōjin, reflecting the historical fusion of Shinto and Buddhism. The grounds include the Reikozuka — ~1,000 red torii gates lining a fox-spirit sanctuary — one of the most atmospheric sights in Aichi.

location.zh: 爱知县豊川市豊川町灵狐塚1
location.en: Reikozuka, Toyokawa-cho, Toyokawa City, Aichi Prefecture

zh: 灵狐塚：约1,000座鸟居与无数狐狸石像营造出浓郁的神秘氛围
本殿：曹洞宗佛教建筑与稻荷信仰的融合，正月三日（元旦至三日）信众逾100万人
境内商店：豊川名物稻荷寿司（油揚げ稲荷）和狐狸造型小吃随处可见
en: Reikozuka: ~1,000 torii gates and countless stone fox statues create an intensely atmospheric fox-spirit sanctuary
Main hall: a rare Buddhist–Shinto fusion sanctuary; over 1 million worshippers visit during the New Year three-day period
Temple precincts: Toyokawa's specialty inari-zushi (tofu-pouch sushi) and fox-themed snacks are sold throughout

tips.zh: 从名古屋乘名铁名古屋本线至豊川稲荷站约40分钟，出站步行约5分钟直达正门。正月（1月1—3日）香火鼎盛，人潮极为拥挤，请做好排队准备。
tips.en: Take the Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line from Nagoya ~40 minutes to Toyokawa-Inari station; a 5-minute walk brings you to the main gate. New Year's Day through 3 January is enormously crowded — prepare for long queues.
